selected_evidence.requirement: SELinux MAC root cause diagnosis and fix
selected_evidence.summary: journalctl showed 'Permission denied' binding 8181 (SELinux, since apachectl configtest passed); confirmed port 8181 was labeled intermapper_port_t, not http_port_t; fixed via semanage port -m and re-verified successful bind

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart identity change and command availability restored
selected_evidence.summary: Polled through timeout until exec succeeded again; new boot_id 1d30a906-a668-4064-a9d7-09bfc69051d9 differs from baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service and SELinux mode
